title: Mixed Conditionals / Kondisiyone Masuraw
bridge: Bamanakan kan, kondisiyone masuraw mana falan falan ye tiɲɲedakolo sira kanu. Mɔgɔ min bɛ εrɛra ka kondisiyone masuraw bɛ ka tugu jati fɔ, u mana kɛ fana ka tugu jati fɔ laban bɛ ka tugu jati fɔ ye. A fɔlɔ, u mana kɛ fana ka tugu jati fɔ laban bɛ ka tugu jati fɔ ye. A fɔlɔ fana, u mana kɛ fana ka tugu jati fɔ laban bɛ ka tugu jati fɔ ye. A fɔlɔ fana, u mana kɛ fana ka tugu jati fɔ laban bɛ ka tugu jati fɔ ye. A fɔlɔ fana, u mana kɛ fana ka tugu jati fɔ laban bɛ ka tugu jati fɔ ye. A fɔlɔ fana, u mana kɛ fana ka tugu jati fɔ laban bɛ ka tugu jati fɔ ye.
rule: Kondisiyone masuraw bɛ ka tugu jati fɔ laban bɛ ka tugu jati fɔ ye (tugu jati 3 + tugu jati 2) n'a fɔlɔ fana, u mana kɛ fana ka tugu jati fɔ laban bɛ ka tugu jati fɔ ye (tugu jati 2 + tugu jati 3). Tugu jati 1: If + past perfect, would + base verb (kondisyon fɔlɔ, tugu jati jɔn). Tugu jati 2: If + simple past, would have + past participle (kondisyon jɔn, tugu jati fɔlɔ). Tugu jati 3: If + past perfect, would have + past participle (kondisyon fɔlɔ, tugu jati fɔlɔ).

title: Advanced Passive Voice: Gerunds, Infinitives, and Modals / Danbɛ kanbɛrɛla: gerundiyala, infinitifow la modow
bridge: Sipaniliden, danbɛ kanbɛrɛla ka jàbira wɛrɛ fana ka lamɛn waati bara ci 'ser + participio' la a b'a taara ka lamɛn kanbɛrɛla jàbira wɛrɛ fana (gerundio/infinitivo). Angliden, danbɛ kanbɛrɛla jàbira dɔrɔn dɔrɔn: i blɛ ka ne 'must be done', 'being done', 'to be done', tɛ mɔgɔkɔrɔfilɛ. Fèniw ka kunmabɔ sɔrɔ la ispanyɛgɛ kanbɛrɛla ka jàbira wɛrɔ filɛ filɛ dɔrɔn dɔrɔn, n'i taara ka ne 'debe ser hecho' a kɛra 'has to be done'. A fòlɔ, angliden, danbɛ kanbɛrɛla ka jàbira wɛrɛ fana ka lamɛn waati bara ci 'by someone' a b'a taara ka lamɛn kanbɛrɛla jàbira wɛrɛ fana, sapaniliden mɔgɔ tɛna sɔrɔ ka a taara ka lamɛn kanbɛrɛla jàbira wɛrɛ fana.
rule: Angliden, danbɛ kanbɛrɛla ka jàbira wɛrɛ fana ka lamɛn waati bara ci 'to be' ka lamɛn wɛrɛ fana, modow la jàbira wɛrɛ fana ka lamɛn waati bara ci, a taara ka lamɛn kanbɛrɛla jàbira wɛrɛ fana. Modow kɔrɔ: modal + be + participio (kɛlɛtamaden: 'must be done', 'can be seen'). Infinitifow kɔrɔ: to be + participio (kɛlɛtamaden: 'to be considered'). Gerundiyow kɔrɔ: being + participio (kɛlɛtamaden: 'being watched'). Modow ka lamɛn wɛrɛ fana kɔrɔ: modal + have been + participio (kɛlɛtamaden: 'should have been informed'). Danbɛ kanbɛrɛla ka jàbira wɛrɛ fana ka lamɛn waati bara ci preposisionw (kɛlɛtamaden: 'This chair was sat on', nka taa kɛra jàbira wɛrɛ fana ka lamɛn waati bara ci). Jàbira wɛrɛ fana ka lamɛn waati bara ci (intransitivos) la danbɛ kanbɛrɛla ka jàbira wɛrɛ fana ka lamɛn waati bara ci: i fòlɔ, i bɛɛ tɛna sɔrɔ ka a taara ka lamɛn kanbɛrɛla jàbira wɛrɛ fana. Sapaniliden, danbɛ kanbɛrɛla ka jàbira wɛrɛ fana ka lamɛn waati bara ci 'se'.

title: Advanced Reported Speech / Fɔlɔɲɛsigi ka kɔfɛ kɛ
bridge: Tɔgɔ, sɔrɔsɔrɔ la, kɛlɛba bɛɛ ka kɔfɛ kɛ fana ka tɔɔrɔ kanu, an ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye ko kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye. Kɔfɛ kɛ ye ko kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye, an ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye fana. Kɔfɛ kɛ ye ko kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye, an ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye fana. Kɔfɛ kɛ ye ko kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye, an ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye fana. Kɔfɛ kɛ ye ko kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye, an ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye fana.
rule:
Kɔfɛ kɛ ka kɔfɛ kɛ fana (B2 tɔgɔ):
1. **Kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu**: Kɛlɛba bɛɛ ka kɔfɛ kɛ fana ka tɔɔrɔ kanu fana ye ko kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye: tɔɔrɔ kanu → tɔɔrɔ kanu fana; tɔɔrɔ kanu fana → tɔɔrɔ kanu fana; tɔɔrɔ kanu fana → tɔɔrɔ kanu fana; tɔɔrɔ kanu fana → tɔɔrɔ kanu fana; will → would; can → could; may → might; must → had to (wala must kɛra fana).
2. **Kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu**: Kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye ko kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye (ye fana kɛra fana): 'He said he is ill' (sira bɛɛ) wala 'He said he was ill' (sira bɛɛ fana).
3. **Kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu**: Kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye ko kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye: 'I' → 'he/she', 'my' → 'his/her', lanin ye.
4. **Kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu**: today → that day; yesterday → the day before / the previous day; tomorrow → the next day / the following day; here → there; now → then.
5. **Kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu**: Kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye ko kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye 'if/whether' kɛra fana, kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye fana. Kɔfɛ kɛ ka tɔɔrɔ bɛɛ kanu fana ye fana: 'Where does he live?' → 'She asked where he lived.'

title: Inversion for Emphasis / Kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ
bridge: A taali gi, kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ ye ko kanbɛlɛn tɛmɛyɔrɔ wala tɔgɔ bɛɛw la ("Nunca había visto algo así"). A ngɛlɛsin kan, sɛbɛn, kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ tun tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ (rarely, not only, never, nɔgɔya) bɛɛ laala juman loon, a tun tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ (do/does/did, have/has, will, can, nɔgɔya) alaa ye jamana bɛɛ la. Kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ tun tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ: sɛbɛn, kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ, a bɛɛ laala juman loon, a tun tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ a taali gi. Kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ: sɛbɛn, kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ. Kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ, a bɛɛ laala juman loon, a tun tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ.
rule: Kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ bɛɛ laala juman loon, a tun tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ. Kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ bɛɛ laala juman loon, a tun tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ: never, rarely, seldom, hardly ever, not only, no sooner, little, under no circumstances, at no time, in no way. Kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ bɛɛ laala juman loon, a tun tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ: [Kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ] + kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ (do/does/did, have/has, will, can, nɔgɔya) + jamana + kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ. Sɛbɛn, kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ, a bɛɛ laala juman loon, a tun tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ 'do' laala juman loon wala 'did' laala juman loon (sɛbɛn 'to be', a tun tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ). 'Not only' bɛɛ laala juman loon, a tun tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ: "Not only did she sing, but she also danced". 'No sooner' bɛɛ laala juman loon, a tun tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ: "No sooner had we arrived than it started raining". Kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ bɛɛ laala juman loon, a tun tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ, a bɛɛ laala juman loon, a tun tɛna kɛlɛya la kɛ fɛn bɔ tɛmɛ.

title: Nominalisation: Turning Verbs and Adjectives into Nouns / Nominalizasi: Kɛmɛkɛla dɔɲɛkanw bɛ sanjɛkanw la
bridge: A fɛrɛsɛ la, nominalizasi bɛrɛbɛ haɲɔɲinin lo ka tɔgɔ la ka jamana kanu. O kɔrɔ, i kɛ mɔgɔ sira ka minw ka sira bɛ tɛmɛ kanu, o tɛ sɔrɔ i ma fɔlɔ a ka sɔrɔnin ka minw ka sira bɛ se ka tɛmɛ kanu. A fɛrɛsɛ la, i kɛ mɔgɔ sira ka minw ka sira bɛ tɛmɛ kanu, o tɛ sɔrɔ i ma fɔlɔ a ka sɔrɔnin ka minw ka sira bɛ se ka tɛmɛ kanu. A fɛrɛsɛ la, i kɛ mɔgɔ sira ka minw ka sira bɛ tɛmɛ kanu, o tɛ sɔrɔ i ma fɔlɔ a ka sɔrɔnin ka minw ka sira bɛ se ka tɛmɛ kanu. Ɛyɛ ka tɛmɛ: tɔgɔ kelen ya min bɛ se ka tɛmɛ kanu, manti jamana kelen ya min bɛ se ka tɛmɛ kanu, fɛrɛsɛgaw bɛɛ tɛmɛ kanu bɛɛ min bɛ se ka tɛmɛ kanu.
rule: B2 la, kɛmɛ mɔgɔw kɔrɔ: 1. Dɔɲɛkanw → sanjɛkanw kanu: -tion (inform → information), -ment (develop → development), -ance/-ence (perform → performance), -al (approve → approval), -ure (fail → failure). 2. Sanjɛkanw → dɔɲɛkanw: -ness (happy → happiness), -ity (active → activity), -th (strong → strength), -ce (important → importance). 3. Kɛmɛkɛla dɔɲɛkanw: choose → choice, believe → belief, prove → proof, lose → loss. 4. Bɔ kɛmɛ: a fɛrɛsɛ la, i kɛ mɔgɔ sira ka minw ka sira bɛ tɛmɛ kanu, o tɛ sɔrɔ i ma fɔlɔ a ka sɔrɔnin ka minw ka sira bɛ se ka tɛmɛ kanu. Kɛlɛya dɔɲɛkanw kanu: 'make a decision' manti 'decide'. 5. Kɛmɛkɛla dɔɲɛkanw: dɔɲɛkanw bɛɛ min bɛ se ka tɛmɛ kanu (change → change), sanjɛkanw bɛɛ min bɛ se ka tɛmɛ kanu (relation vs. relationship).

title: Advanced Modal Verbs: Would Have, Should Have, etc. / Mɔgɔ minw ka tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira: would have, should have, tinw
bridge: Tɛ baara minw ka tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira, an bɛ se ka kanu i k'a sira tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira (habría hecho, debería haber hecho) wala an bɛ se ka kanu i k'a sira tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira (imperfecto de subjuntivo). Nka, tɛ anglisi kan, an na tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira (would, should, could, might) ka tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira 'have' lajɛ. Tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira minw ka tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira, an bɛ se ka kanu i k'a sira tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira 'haber' + participio, nka tɛ anglisi kan, tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira minw ka tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira, an bɛ se ka kanu i k'a sira tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira modal + 'have' + participio. Tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira minw ka tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira, an bɛ se ka kanu i k'a sira tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira 'would have' ka tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira 'habría tenido' tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira, nka a ka tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira minw ka tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira kondisionali tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira tɛmɛ kɛ fana sira.

title: Participle Clauses / Klaaɲukanw dɔɲɛɲumanw
bridge: A taali giɲa kan, i kɛra don dɔɲɛɲumanw kanbeen'izɛɛn'izɛyɔrɔ, 'kɔfale', 'ala taara' wala 'kɔfale bɛɛ fɔlɔ' ka kɛra verbeyɔrɔ. A angle kan, ma sira ka kɛ kelen kelen n'a taali wala n'a fɛ, o kɛra klaaɲukanw dɔɲɛɲumanw (ala taara wala kɔ). Kɔrɔsiw bɛɛ se a angle kan, klaaɲukanw dɔɲɛɲumanw ka tɔgɔ la ka tɔgɔ dɔɲɛɲumanw ka tɔgɔ ma sira kɛnɛ ka tɔgɔ, o sɔrɔ la, a kɛra 'dangling participle' (klaaɲu ka kɛra) ka bɔ kɔrɔsiw bɛɛ. A taali giɲa kan, gerundiw ('caminando por la calle, vi...') ka kɛra, nka, a angle kan, klaaɲukanw ala taara ('walking down the street, I saw...') ka kɛra ka tɔgɔ la ka tɔgɔ, o sɔrɔ la, a kɛra 'having' ka kɛra klaaɲukanw kɔrɔsiw bɛɛ.
rule: Klaaɲukanw dɔɲɛɲumanw ka kɛra klaaɲukanw ala taara (-ing) wala klaaɲukanw kɔ (-ed wala jɛnɲɔgɔnya). O kɛra ala taara (kɔfale, kɔ), kɔ (ala taara, kɔfale), jɔra (si), wala musukun (muso). Klaaɲukanw dɔɲɛɲumanw ka kɛra dɔɲɛɲumanw ka tɔgɔ wala tɔgɔ dɔɲɛɲumanw ka tɔgɔ, nka dɔɲɛɲumanw ka tɔgɔ ma sira kɛnɛ ka tɔgɔ. Kɔrɔsiw bɛɛ se kɔ kɛra dɔɲɛɲumanw ka tɔgɔ, o kɛra 'having + klaaɲukanw kɔ' (e.g., 'Having finished my homework, I went out'). A kɛra pasiw ka kɛra 'being + klaaɲukanw kɔ' (e.g., 'Being late, I missed the bus'). A ka tɛmɛ kɛra tɛmɛyɔrɔ ka kɛra dɔɲɛɲumanw jɛnɲɔgɔnya (e.g., 'the man sitting there' = 'the man who is sitting there'). O kɛra tɔgɔ ma sira kɛnɛ ka tɔgɔ; o sɔrɔ la, a kɛra dɔɲɛɲumanw ka kɛra 'while', 'because', etc. ka kɛra.

title: Future Perfect and Continuous / Kɔfale bɛɛn nin kɔfale kanbɛlɛn
bridge: Sipanilɛn, an b'a sɔrɔ kɔfale banaw bɛ an ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya, amma tilifonikan, u ka kanbɛlɛya kɛ kelen kɔfale bɛɛn nin kelen kɔfale kanbɛlɛn ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya. Kɔfale bɛɛn (will have + participio) ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya ka sɔrɔ kɔ kɔfale bɛɛn ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya ye ko 'habré + participio' ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya, amma jɔ, sipathilɔgili, an ka sɔrɔ kɔfale banaw bɛ an ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya, amma tilifonikan, u ka kanbɛlɛya kɛ kelen kɔfale bɛɛn nin kelen kɔfale kanbɛlɛn ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya. Kɔfale kanbɛlɛn (will be + -ing) ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya sɛbɛn ka sɔrɔ kɔ sipathilɔgili; an ka sɔrɔ 'estaré haciendo' ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya wala kɔfale banaw bɛɛ, an ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya ka sɔrɔ kɔ kanbɛlɛya kɛlɛya.
rule: Tilifonikan, kɔfale bɛɛn ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya ka sɔrɔ kɔ 'will have' + participio bɛɛn ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya, o kɔ kelen ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya bɛ an ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya ka sɔrɔ kɔ kelen kɔfale bɛɛn ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya. Tɔɔrɔ: 'By 2025, I will have finished my degree.' Kɔfale kanbɛlɛn ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya ka sɔrɔ kɔ 'will be' + verbo en -ing ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya, o kɔ kelen ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya bɛ an ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya ka sɔrɔ kɔ kelen kɔfale kanbɛlɛn ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya. Tɔɔrɔ: 'At 8 p.m., I will be having dinner.' O b'a sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya bɛ an ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya ka sɔrɔ kɔ kelen kɔfale bɛɛn wala kɔfale kanbɛlɛn ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya: 'When you arrive, I will have cooked dinner.' Kɔfale bɛɛn kanbɛlɛn (will have been + -ing) ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya sɛbɛn ka sɔrɔ kɔ tilifonikan, o kɔ kelen ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya bɛ an ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya ka sɔrɔ kɔ kelen kɔfale bɛɛn kanbɛlɛn ka sɔrɔ kɔnɔni kɛlɛya: 'By June, I will have been living here for six months.'

title: Discourse Markers for Cohesion / Marikadenw bamanankan kanu
bridge: Bamanankan, marikadenw bamanankan (n'a ta ye « nebenenalen », « ye fana », « a b'a la ») b'a miiri k'a jati kelen tɛ faliw kelen koo la, a ka koo sira kelen koo la. A ka kelen ye fana, an ka tugu an ka sira kelen koo la, an ka tolontrenw ye fana, an ka sira kelen koo la. N'a ta ye « however » (nebenenalen) a ka miiri kelen tɛ faliw kelen koo la, a ka sira kelen koo la, a ka tolontrenw ye fana koo la. N'a ta ye « although » (a b'a la) a ka miiri kelen tɛ faliw kelen koo la, a ka sira kelen koo la, a ka tolontrenw ye fana koo la. N'a ta ye « therefore » (ye fana) a ka miiri kelen tɛ faliw kelen koo la, a ka sira kelen koo la, a ka tolontrenw ye fana koo la. N'a ta ye « so » (a b'a la) a ka miiri kelen tɛ faliw kelen koo la, a ka sira kelen koo la, a ka tolontrenw ye fana koo la.
rule: Marikadenw bamanankan kanu (B2) b'a miiri kelen tɛ faliw kelen koo la: aditif (furthermore, moreover, in addition), kontrati (however, nevertheless, on the other hand, whereas), ka denw/sabi denw (therefore, consequently, as a result, thus), tugu (firstly, secondly, finally, meanwhile), ka kaanw (in other words, that is to say). Regles ka kaanw: 1) 'However' b'a miiri kelen tɛ faliw kelen koo la, a ka sira kelen koo la, a ka tolontrenw ye fana koo la. Ex: 'The weather was bad. However, we went out.' / 'The weather was bad. We went out, however.' 2) 'Although' b'a miiri kelen tɛ faliw kelen koo la, a ka sira kelen koo la, a ka tolontrenw ye fana koo la; a ka sira kelen koo la a ka tolontrenw ye fana koo la: 'Although it was raining, we went out' (a ka sira kelen koo la 'although'). 3) 'Therefore' ka 'consequently' b'a miiri kelen tɛ faliw kelen koo la, a ka sira kelen koo la, a ka tolontrenw ye fana koo la; 'so' b'a miiri kelen tɛ faliw kelen koo la, a ka sira kelen koo la, a ka tolontrenw ye fana koo la. 4) 'On the other hand' b'a miiri kelen tɛ faliw kelen koo la, a ka sira kelen koo la, a ka tolontrenw ye fana koo la. 5) Bamanankan, tolontrenw ye fana b'a miiri kelen tɛ faliw kelen koo la: kelen tugu b'a miiri kelen tɛ faliw kelen koo la, a ka sira kelen koo la, a ka tolontrenw ye fana koo la (error comun: 'It was raining, however, we went out' → komi, b'a miiri kelen tɛ faliw kelen koo la 'It was raining; however, we went out'). 6) Marikadenw tugu ('firstly', 'secondly', 'finally') b'a miiri kelen tɛ faliw kelen koo la, a ka sira kelen koo la, a ka tolontrenw ye fana koo la. Bamanankan, an ka tugu an ka sira kelen koo la, an ka tolontrenw ye fana koo la.

title: Hedging Language / Kɛlɛya kɔfɛ
bridge: A tɛ sinikɛlɛn, mɔgɔ min bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu bɛɛ, an ka fɔlɔ fɔlɔ bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu. A anglesekɛlɛn, kɛlɛya kɔfɛ bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu bɛɛ, an ka fɔlɔ fɔlɔ bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu. Kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu bɛɛ, an ka fɔlɔ fɔlɔ bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu. Kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu bɛɛ, an ka fɔlɔ fɔlɔ bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu. Kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu bɛɛ, an ka fɔlɔ fɔlɔ bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu.
rule: A anglesekɛlɛn, kɛlɛya kɔfɛ bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu bɛɛ, an ka fɔlɔ fɔlɔ bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu. 1) Kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu: may, might, could, can. Ɛnkɔrɔ: 'It might rain' (A ka tɛ sira). 2) Kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu: usually, generally, apparently, presumably. Ɛnkɔrɔ: 'Apparently, he left early' (A ka tɛ sira). 3) Kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu: I think, I believe, I suppose, I tend to think. Ɛnkɔrɔ: 'I tend to agree with you' (N ka tɛ sira). 4) Kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu: It seems that, It appears that, It is said that. Ɛnkɔrɔ: 'It seems that she is tired' (A ka tɛ sira). 5) Kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu: 'tend to' + infinitive. Ɛnkɔrɔ: 'He tends to arrive late' (A ka tɛ sira). 6) 'Apparently' bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu, 'seemingly' bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu. 7) 'Rather' la 'quite' bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu. Ɛnkɔrɔ: 'It's rather expensive' (A ka tɛ sira). 8) A akadɛmikikɛn, 'would seem' la 'could be argued' bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu. Tɛmɛ na, a tɛ sinikɛlɛn, mɔgɔ min bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu bɛɛ, an ka fɔlɔ fɔlɔ bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu: 'It seems that he is sick' (A ka tɛ sira).
